batch_production_workflow.goal: Create 12 Shorts (1 month supply) in one 4-hour session
preparation: Select 12 gallery images from website/public/gallery/ (diverse styles and animals)
Download 12 original pet photos (from Instagram DMs, email submissions, or stock)
Install CapCut Desktop (free) or DaVinci Resolve
Download trending audio tracks from YouTube Audio Library or Epidemic Sound
Create thumbnail template in Canva (1080x1920, vertical)

production_steps.details: Choose 2 templates (e.g., 6x Before/After Reveal + 6x Style Comparison). Repetition builds pattern recognition.
Import all 12 images + original photos into editing software
Spend 30-40 minutes perfecting Template 1 Video 1. This becomes the blueprint.
Duplicate project 5 times, swap images only. Maintains consistent pacing/transitions.
Update hook text for each video (use hook_variants from templates above)
Export all 6 videos: 1080x1920, 30fps, MP4, high quality
Build second template, duplicate 5 times, export remaining 6 videos

batch_production_workflow.time_estimate: 4 hours for 12 Shorts (20 min per video)
pro_tips: Use CapCut's 'Template' feature to save your custom layouts
Create a 'Shorts Assets' folder with pre-sized logos, CTAs, end screens
Batch export overnight if rendering takes long
Schedule all 12 uploads at once (Mon/Wed/Fri for 4 weeks)
